source: User-supplied resources/lyrics-spelling/嘿! 朋友-夕陽武士

blocks.text: 嘿 我的好朋友為啥物會目屎流
blocks.spelling: heh guá ê hó-pîng-iú uī-siánn-mi̍h ē ba̍k-sái lâu

blocks.text: 是啥物代誌 乎你艱苦
blocks.spelling: sī siánn-mi̍h tāi-tsì hô lí kan-khóo

blocks.text: 嘿 我的好朋友為得啥遮爾滿足
blocks.spelling: heh guá ê hó-pîng-iú uī-tio̍h siánn tsiah-nī buán-tsiok

blocks.text: 是啥物原因 乎你快樂
blocks.spelling: sī siánn-mi̍h guân-in hô lí khuài-lo̍k

blocks.text: 將你的傷心 囥佇昨日 好好迎接 新的快樂
blocks.spelling: tsiòng lí ê siong-sim khǹg tī tso̍h-li̍t hó hó gîng-tsiap sin ê khuài-lo̍k

blocks.text: 不用煩惱 我會陪你 啉酒到透早
blocks.spelling: m̄-bián huân-ló guá ē puê lí lim tsiú kàu thàu-tsá

blocks.text: 悲傷的心 總是難免 這款滋味 總是會過
blocks.spelling: pi-siong ê sim tsóng-sī lân-bián tsit-khuán tsu-bī tsóng-sī ē kuè

blocks.text: 若是不爽 歡迎找我
blocks.spelling: nā-sī buē sóng huan-gîng tshuē guá

blocks.text: 若是孤單 歡迎找我
若是艱苦 歡迎找我
